# Test fixture attribution

## tomato-early-blight.jpg

- **Subject:** A tomato leaf showing typical target-shaped lesions of *Alternaria solani* (early blight).
- **Author:** Clemson University – USDA Cooperative Extension Slide Series, Bugwood.org (image 1233052).
- **Source:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alternaria_solani_-_leaf_lesions.jpg
- **License:** [CC BY 3.0 US](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/deed.en)
- **Changes:** resized to 640 px wide and re-encoded as JPEG.

Used only for automated tests and the manual inference verification script.

## not-an-image.jpg

A plain-text file with a `.jpg` extension, used to test that file-signature validation rejects non-images. Created for this project.
